Post digestion, add 2 uL loading dye to each sample and then run these on a 2.5% agarose gel. Stain with SYBR Green.

Gel loading order:

Con, A0-A6 \=\> *MspJI*  
Con, A0-A6 \=\> *HaeIII*  
Con, A0-A6 \=\> *MspI*  
Con, A0-A6 \=\> *HpaII*

I also loaded the original ETS ligand at the end of each gel row.
